title: Dispatch: eshyra rules CLI management workflow (attempt 1)
description:
Implements eshyra-jhpt.5 (read its spec + acceptance criteria). Base: eshyra-jhpt @ 26f9879 (main + .4 auditor parity). Everything below is DECIDED; implement it, do not redesign.

WORKTREE / BRANCH: .worktrees/eshyra-jhpt.5.1 on branch eshyra-jhpt.5.1. npm ci already run.

CODE SURVEY (supervisor, exact pointers):
- Storage APIs (packages/core/src/campaign/campaignRuleStore.ts): createCampaignRule(db, rule, {currentPosition, validation?}), supersedeCampaignRule(db, {campaignId, ruleIdentity, successor, currentPosition, validation?}), revokeCampaignRule(db, {campaignId, ruleIdentity, revokedPosition, currentPosition}), getCampaignRule(db, {campaignId, ruleIdentity}), listCampaignRules(db, {campaignId}) (ordered by effective position), listActiveCampaignRulesAtPosition(db, campaignId, formattedPosition). Admission (rev10/rev15): ordinary prospective effective/revoked positions must have ordinal > the persisted current ordinal and are canonicalized to the __future__ anchor; currentPosition MUST equal getCurrentCampaignPosition(db, campaignId) (packages/core/src/campaign/campaignPosition.ts), or {sessionId, turnId, ordinal: 0} when no turn has been persisted (assertCurrentPosition). A scheduled successor cannot be revoked before it takes effect ("supersede it instead"). Errors are CampaignRuleError with distinctive messages — surface err.message verbatim.
- Domain (packages/core/src/campaign/campaignRules.ts): CampaignRule {ruleIdentity, campaignId, ruleKind 'ruling'|'house-rule', status, origin 'player-authored'|'player-approved'|'oracle-supplied', provenance {kind:'ambiguity', ambiguityId, selectedInterpretationId} | {kind:'recurring-question', questionId} | {kind:'house-rule', rationale?}, effectivePosition, temporalMode {mode:'prospective'}, supersededBy, revokedPosition, scope, governingRecordKeys[], prose}. validateCampaignRule needs options.ambiguity (a RulesAmbiguity) for ambiguity rulings. formatCampaignPosition/parseCampaignPosition.
- Ambiguity metadata for validation: assembleCampaignRulesContext(db, campaignId, formattedPosition, resolveStrictCampaignRulesStack(db)) (packages/core/src/campaign/campaignContext.ts, packages/core/src/state/campaignRecordLookup.ts) returns .ambiguities[{ambiguity: RulesAmbiguity, ruling, conflictingRulings}]; find the ambiguity by id there and pass {ambiguity} as validation. CampaignRulesBindingResolutionError / RulesPackError propagate — print the message and exit 1.
- Root export boundary: packages/cli must import ONLY from '@eshyra/core' (packages/cli/test/internalBoundary.test.ts enforces it). NONE of the above campaign-rule symbols are on the root export yet (packages/core/src/index.ts). AGENTS.md: promote to root only when a real consumer needs it — the CLI is that consumer. PROMOTE exactly: createCampaignRule, supersedeCampaignRule, revokeCampaignRule, getCampaignRule, listCampaignRules, listActiveCampaignRulesAtPosition, getCurrentCampaignPosition, formatCampaignPosition, parseCampaignPosition, validateCampaignRules, assembleCampaignRulesContext, resolveStrictCampaignRulesStack, CampaignRuleError, and the types CampaignRule, CampaignPosition, CampaignRuleKind, CampaignRuleProvenance, CampaignRuleStatus, CampaignRulesContext, RulesAmbiguity. Keep /internal exports as they are.
- CLI shape to copy: packages/cli/src/checkpoints.ts (Deps {root, env, log}; resolveDb via resolveCampaignDbPath(deps.root, {explicitDbPath: env.ESHYRA_DB_PATH, campaignId}); '<cmd> <sub> ... [campaign-id]' dispatcher; usage line + exit 1 on bad args) and packages/cli/src/adventures.ts (opens the db with openDatabase(dbPath), reads the campaign via getCampaign(db) -> campaign.campaignId). Wire 'rules' into packages/cli/src/index.ts main() next to the 'checkpoint' branch with a runRulesSubcommand mirroring runCheckpointSubcommand. Tests copy packages/cli/test/checkpoints.test.ts's harness (temp data root, env, logs[]; campaign db via openDatabase+initSchema+createCampaign(db,{campaignId:'c1', pack: EMBERFALL_HOLLOW})).

COMMAND CONTRACT — packages/cli/src/rules.ts, 'eshyra rules <list|show|history|add|supersede|revoke> [flags] [campaign-id]'. Flags are '--name value' (write a tiny flag parser in the file; no new dependency). Every command opens the db, reads campaignId via getCampaign(db), computes current = getCurrentCampaignPosition(db, campaignId) ?? {sessionId:'cli', turnId:'bootstrap', ordinal:0}.
- list [--at <ordinal>|--all]: default prints the ACTIVE rules at the current position (listActiveCampaignRulesAtPosition at formatCampaignPosition(current)); --at N uses {__future__ anchors? NO — use the persisted position for N via the rows in listCampaignRules? SIMPLER: --at accepts a formatted position string or an ordinal; for an ordinal use {sessionId:'__future__', turnId:'__future__', ordinal:N} which sorts before real anchors at that ordinal and therefore includes everything effective at or before N}; --all prints every rule with status. One line per rule: '<identity>  [<kind>/<status>]  effective <ordinal>  <provenance summary>  — <prose first 80 chars>'.
- show <identity>: full record: identity, kind, status, origin, provenance (ambiguity+interpretation / question / rationale), scope, governing record keys, effective position (formatted), temporal mode, supersededBy, revokedPosition, prose.
- history <identity>: walk the chain backwards (rules whose supersededBy === identity) and forwards (supersededBy) and print the ordered chain with each hop's status, effective and revoked positions.
- add --kind <ruling|house-rule> --prose <text> --scope <text> --records <k1,k2> [--identity <id>] [--effective <ordinal>] [--origin player-authored|player-approved] and provenance flags: house-rule: [--rationale <text>]; ruling: EITHER --ambiguity <id> --interpretation <id> (validated against the bound pack's ambiguity via assembleCampaignRulesContext; unknown id -> list the known ambiguity ids and exit 1; unknown interpretation -> list that ambiguity's interpretation ids and exit 1) OR --question <id>. Identity default: '<kind>:<slug of first 5 prose words>:<ordinal>' (deterministic, no timestamps; collision -> error from the store). Effective default: current.ordinal + 1; --effective must be > current.ordinal (let the store reject and print its message). temporalMode is ALWAYS prospective here (the disputed-turn path belongs to .8). Origin default player-authored. On success print a confirmation with identity, status, effective ordinal, provenance, and 'takes effect from turn <ordinal>'.
- supersede <identity> --prose <text> [--scope] [--records] [--identity] [--effective] [--rationale|--ambiguity/--interpretation|--question]: builds the successor from the prior (same kind/scope/records/provenance unless overridden), effective default current.ordinal + 1, calls supersedeCampaignRule; prints prior -> successor with both effective positions.
- revoke <identity> [--at <ordinal>]: revokedPosition default current.ordinal + 1 (must be > current); prints 'revoked from turn <ordinal>'; store errors verbatim (including the scheduled-successor message).
- Prose must be non-empty and player-provided; there is NO model call anywhere in this command.

EVIDENCE — packages/cli/test/rules.test.ts (must FAIL against 26f9879 because the command does not exist), covering: add house-rule and ruling (valid ambiguity from EMBERFALL_HOLLOW's bound SRD pack — pick a real ambiguity id via assembleCampaignRulesContext in the test, e.g. one of the create-undead / find-familiar ids); unknown ambiguity and unknown interpretation rejections listing the known ids; list active vs --all vs --at; show; supersede then history shows the chain; revoke then list omits it after the revocation ordinal and --all shows status revoked with revokedPosition; revoke at or before current rejected with the store's message; cross-campaign isolation (two dbs); bad subcommand/usage exit 1; every success confirmation mentions effective timing and provenance. Also extend packages/core/test (a root-export test if one exists, else packages/cli/test/internalBoundary.test.ts stays green) and add a docs/cli note if docs list CLI commands (grep docs for 'eshyra checkpoint').

VERIFICATION: npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing (it runs both packages); report pass/skip counts and confirm worktree-local resolution. Do not modify campaignRuleStore.ts or campaignRules.ts; if a store limitation blocks a command, record it in your notes and file a bead rather than working around it.
